name: docker-compose

components.built_service: native runtime detected from the build context (Dockerfile only if no native runtime fits)

unknown_image.detail: third-party image with no add-on: Docker app (one container per app; persistence only through add-ons/Cellar)

profiles_only.detail: service behind a compose profile (not started by default): run it once by hand or as a Clever Task if needed

components.no_ports_custom: background process: needs an HTTP listener on 8080 to be its own app, or CC_WORKER_COMMAND on an app of the same runtime

traps: Compose service names used as hostnames (redis, db) do not resolve on Clever: read the add-on variables instead.
depends_on ordering does not exist: each app must retry its connections at start.
Bind mounts (./src:/app) are local dev live-reload: ignore them; named volumes of a database vanish into the add-on.
Port mappings (8080:80) are irrelevant: the app listens on $PORT (8080).
Hard-coded credentials in code (e.g. postgres/postgres) must become add-on variables; never copy them.
Clever Kubernetes only when more than ~3 custom containers must stay containers together, and never in an HDS zone.
